periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axis of the patches is oriented obliquely, angled approximately 30 degrees outward from the vertical facial midline toward the ears.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Ovaloid morphology with a vertical elongation; the visual ratio of height to width is approximately 1.8:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: The patches exhibit a downward tapering effect, with the center of mass shifted slightly above the narrowest inferior point.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band covers approximately 40-45% of the visible vertical torso length at the lateral flanks.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The gap between the medial margins of the ears is approximately 1.5 times the width of a single ear base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The superior boundary of the pinnae exhibits a smooth, continuous semi-circular curvature.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant reddish-brown (rufous) pigmentation is visible on the fur of the lower abdomen and inner hind limbs, contrasting with the primary white pelage.
